text.content:
This is clearly the heart of the floor: Overcrowded, deliberately spacious, and unmistakably occupied.

GM Notes

Objective: The stairwell down to the next floor is here - whatever holds this room is standing between the party and it.

Milestone: This is where the floor's story comes to a head: the Wool-Crowned King and his stolen throne of saddlebags started as a joke - a goblin sat on a llama once, on a dare - and now it's the closest thing this warren has to a government. Its name is Corvin Blackwell, Drover of the Wool-Crowned King and his stolen throne of saddlebags. The stairs down to the next floor are here too - finding them means going through whatever's guarding this room first.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 14 to detect and counter).
